title: NavLogProfile

cruise_tas_kt.description: At its cruise power at cruise_altitude_ft (else 6,000 ft) on a standard day.

descent_ias_kt.description: The descent's indicated airspeed, knots, as the POH gives it; flown as a TAS at the descent's middle altitude. Null or left out: the descent is flown on the cruise's figures.

descent_fuel_burn_gph.description: The descent's fuel flow, gallons an hour, from the POH.

description: An airplane's profile (data/aircraft/*.json, a pilot's own figures laid over it). A figure of 0 is taken as none.
